findings.title: Bucket example-public-site grants READ to everyone
findings.description: s3scanner found that anyone on the internet can list the objects of the aws bucket example-public-site (region us-west-2): its ACL grants READ to everyone.
findings.remediation: Remove the AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers grant from the bucket ACL, enable S3 Block Public Access on the bucket and the account, and set Object Ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced so ACLs no longer apply.

findings.title: Bucket example-public-site grants READ to any authenticated user
findings.description: s3scanner found that any authenticated cloud account can list the objects of the aws bucket example-public-site (region us-west-2): its ACL grants READ to any authenticated user.
findings.remediation: Remove the AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers grant from the bucket ACL, enable S3 Block Public Access on the bucket and the account, and set Object Ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced so ACLs no longer apply.

findings.remediation: Remove the AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers grant from the bucket ACL, enable S3 Block Public Access on the bucket and the account, and set Object Ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced so ACLs no longer apply.

findings.remediation: Remove the AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers grant from the bucket ACL, enable S3 Block Public Access on the bucket and the account, and set Object Ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced so ACLs no longer apply.

findings.title: Bucket example-assets grants READ to everyone
findings.description: s3scanner found that anyone on the internet can list the objects of the digitalocean bucket example-assets (region nyc3): its ACL grants READ to everyone.
findings.remediation: Remove the public grant from the bucket ACL (and any bucket policy that grants the same), then confirm with s3scanner.
